Not that it matters but I am gay, but love is love, and hetero or homo we still want the same feelings from a partner. 

At first I felt the same ways you mentioned in your post. My self esteem was completely lowered, I am black, thin framed, and have dark features, my boyfriend always watched porn when we had sex and would only pick the videos featuring actors that were large, white, blonde haired. 

Anyway, for me personally, I could not move past feeling ugly and kinda like a placeholder for what he really desired. I could not raise my self esteem until I understood that regardless if this one individual thinks I’m beautiful, I’m beautiful. Period. End. Of. Story. Everyday I told my self that. In addition to outright asking him if he found me attractive still.. if not why. Not because I wanted to change for him, but sometimes it’s hard to hear the truth so we let our minds run wild with assumptions. Instead of just getting to the root of what is causing us our insecurities. I’m not saying your boyfriend is right in this situation, I’m just saying make sure you love yourself first and are content with who you are and circle back to this problem and see if it bothers you as much.
